full.description: This is a gross pathology photograph of a human heart specimen showing the opened left ventricle and aortic valve. There are prominent, friable, reddish-pink vegetations along the valve cusps, indicative of an acute infectious process. The extensive damage and destruction of the valve tissue are characteristic of acute infective endocarditis. Such destructive lesions are frequently caused by virulent bacterial pathogens like Staphylococcus aureus.
